training.purpose: maintain the House Tang Tang Champion qualification and elite formation readiness without tying the rank to one commander
development_rules: verified training exposure accumulates by cohort and by persistent Champion identity when individual detail is material
growth uses the same age aptitude current-capability health and diminishing-return law as exact-person training when an individual Champion is materialized
ordinary House Tang and Sword Manor cohorts remain aggregate distributions until a person crosses the Tang Champion promotion boundary
assignment-specific training may overlay this institutional program but does not change House Tang ownership or create duplicate people
